target: Verify whether xAI supports a batch API equivalent. Phase D consensus flagged xAI batch as undocumented — the RTE XAIBatchClient inherits from OpenAIBatchClient with base_url=https://api.x.ai/v1 but the xAI endpoint may not honor /v1/batches or accept the same JSONL format. This packet runs a single dry probe against xAI (with explicit operator consent + minimum-cost dummy request) to determine batch support, then updates the cost profile registry + spend ledger to either honor or refuse xAI batch with a clear error.
invariants: Live xAI API call required for the probe. Operator must set DPMX_LIVE_OK=1 AND XAI_API_KEY before this packet runs. Probe spend bounded to ≤$0.10 via --max-cost-usd.
Probe uses the cheapest xAI model (grok-code-fast-1 at $0.10/$0.40 per M) and the smallest possible payload (~100 tokens) to keep the live-test cost under $0.0001.

If the probe shows xAI batch is unsupported: XAIBatchClient.submit() raises UnsupportedBatchProvider matching the OpenRouterBatchClient pattern; COST_PROFILES are updated to drop is_batch=True flags from any xai route.
If the probe shows xAI batch IS supported: capture the exact response format + endpoint paths in a separate proof artifact; XAIBatchClient.fetch_results() is verified against that shape.
Do not modify pricing.yaml or model_map.yaml v3 — xAI batch discount field stays null until this packet resolves the support question authoritatively.
Preserve Dopemux split authority boundaries per AGENTS.md §6.

pr.title: verify(rte): xAI batch API support probe + spend ledger / batch_clients update
pr.body:
## Summary
- Runs a minimum-cost (~$0.0001) live probe against xAI to determine if /v1/batches accepts requests in OpenAI-compatible JSONL format.
- Updates `batch_clients.XAIBatchClient` based on the probe result: if unsupported, raise UnsupportedBatchProvider; if supported, document the verified response shape in a separate XAI_BATCH_VERDICT.md proof artifact.
- Updates `spend_ledger` and `run_extraction_v5` COST_PROFILES to either allow or disallow `is_batch=True` for xAI routes.
- Captures the probe transcript and verdict as durable proof.

## Scope
Limited to batch_clients (XAIBatchClient class behavior), spend_ledger (xAI batch_discount field), run_extraction_v5 (cost profile batch toggle for xAI), one verification script, one test file.

## Validation
Probe runs with DPMX_LIVE_OK=1 + XAI_API_KEY + --max-cost-usd $0.10. Probe transcript captured. Verdict authored. Tests verify the runtime now behaves consistently with the verdict (raise or honor).

## NOT_RUN
- The probe runs ONCE under operator supervision. CI does NOT re-run the probe — the verdict is stable until xAI changes their API.

## Residual Risks / UNKNOWNs
- xAI could add batch support in the future; verdict needs re-validation if a future audit flags xAI batch as desirable. Capture the probe-date in the verdict so re-validation cadence is visible.
- Probe spend should be ≤$0.0001 but operator must confirm before greenlight.

@codex review

steps.task: Preflight: verify worktree clean. Verify operator has set DPMX_LIVE_OK=1 and XAI_API_KEY. Verify `--max-cost-usd 0.10` will be passed to the probe.
commands: test "$DPMX_LIVE_OK" = "1" || echo 'STOP: DPMX_LIVE_OK not set to 1'
validation: All preflight checks pass; otherwise STOP and request operator to set required env vars.

steps.task: Author `scripts/verify_xai_batch_support.py`. Script does three things in sequence: (1) POST a single-request batch payload to `https://api.x.ai/v1/batches` using the OpenAI batch JSONL format (custom_id + model + messages); (2) capture HTTP status, response body, error message; (3) if accepted, POST a poll request to `/v1/batches/{id}`; (4) emit a transcript JSON with all four request/response pairs.
validation: Script handles all common failure modes (404 endpoint missing, 405 method not allowed, 401 auth, 400 schema mismatch) and records each in the transcript.
Script honors --max-cost-usd via early-exit if pre-call cost estimate exceeds the cap.

steps.task: Run the probe with operator authorization. Capture stdout/stderr to XAI_BATCH_PROBE_TRANSCRIPT.md.
validation: Probe spend recorded; total ≤$0.0001 sanity check.

steps.task: Author XAI_BATCH_VERDICT.md based on the transcript. Verdict is one of: SUPPORTED (with response-shape documentation), UNSUPPORTED (with the specific failure mode that proves it), or UNCERTAIN (if the probe was inconclusive — e.g., xAI returned 503 indicating temporary issue; retry recommended).
validation: Verdict file contains: probe date, xAI API response, verdict (SUPPORTED/UNSUPPORTED/UNCERTAIN), next-action recommendation.

steps.task: Update XAIBatchClient in batch_clients.py based on verdict. If UNSUPPORTED: change `class XAIBatchClient(OpenAIBatchClient)` to raise UnsupportedBatchProvider in its `submit()` (matching OpenRouterBatchClient pattern). If SUPPORTED: verify the existing inheritance pattern works against the documented response shape; add an xAI-specific response parser if needed. If UNCERTAIN: leave the existing inheritance in place but raise a more informative error message recommending operator opt-in via env var.

Update spend_ledger pricing rows for xAI models: set batch_discount based on verdict. If SUPPORTED: confirm the discount (likely 0.5 like other providers); if UNSUPPORTED: leave at null. Update via pricing.yaml only — do not edit the spend_ledger code path.
Update run_extraction_v5.py COST_PROFILES based on verdict: if UNSUPPORTED, ensure no xAI route has is_batch=True attribute set; if SUPPORTED, allow opt-in via metadata on individual routes.
validation: All cost profile xAI routes consistent with verdict.

steps.task: Write test_xai_batch_support_resolution.py (5+ tests): if UNSUPPORTED — XAIBatchClient.submit raises UnsupportedBatchProvider; spend_ledger refuses to apply batch_discount to xai routes; if SUPPORTED — XAIBatchClient round-trip works on mocked response; spend_ledger applies batch_discount when is_batch=True on an xai route.
validation: Tests are conditional on the verdict (read XAI_BATCH_VERDICT.md at test collect time).

steps.task: Run pal/codereview + pal/precommit. Commit allowlisted files; push; open PR.
validation: PR body links the XAI_BATCH_VERDICT.md and notes the probe date.

steps.task: Emit PROOF.json + sha256sums.txt referencing the transcript and verdict.
validation: PROOF.json includes the verdict, probe spend, and re-validation cadence recommendation.
